description: Small real-world pilot evaluation dataset constructed under Phase 6B-2A to validate data acquisition, double-blind annotation, disagreement adjudication, and quality control workflows.
provenance_policy: Strict provenance capture with mandatory source URLs, retrieval timestamps, and publisher authority ratings. Ground truth established via double-blind human annotation.
annotation_policy: Double-blind human annotation with anonymized IDs (ANN-1042, ANN-2091). Zero model-assisted or LLM predictions permitted in ground truth. Disagreements adjudicated by lead domain expert.
notes: PILOT / NOT FOR FINAL BENCHMARK. Isolated sample testing workflow.
